description: This file contains functions for generating behavior observation plots, including bar plots of behavior durations and counts, and time diagram plots (like Gantt charts) for behavioral events, within the BORIS behavioral observation software.

methods.name: default_value
methods.description: Returns a default value for behavior duration, especially for point events, based on behavior type and parameters.

methods.name: init_behav_modif
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary with subjects, behaviors, and modifiers, setting default values for parameters.

methods.name: init_behav
methods.description: Initializes a dictionary with subjects, behaviors, and parameters, setting default values.

methods.name: create_behaviors_bar_plot
methods.description: Creates bar plots showing behavior durations and occurrence counts over a specified time interval for selected subjects and behaviors.

methods.name: create_events_plot
methods.description: Creates a time diagram (Gantt chart-like) plot of behavior events over time for selected subjects and behaviors.
